individual-data-points.explanation: Panel shows an H&E micrograph alongside spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue spots; heatmaps/spatial maps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel consists solely of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; no averaged/quantitative plot is present.
Scatter/dot plot of TMPRSS11B mRNA levels shows each individual patient tumor sample as a separate dot for both LUAD and LUSC groups, with median and 95% CI indicated.
Bar graph of qRT-PCR data displays individual replicate dots overlaid on the mean±SD bars for each of the four conditions.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - panel A contains an H&E image and color-scaled spatial expression heatmaps, no error bars present.
not needed - panel B contains only micrographs (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence images), no plots or error bars.
PASS - the median line and confidence interval shown on the dot plot are explicitly defined in the caption as median with 95% CI.
PASS - the error bars on the bar graph are defined in the caption as mean plus or minus standard deviation.
